title: Al-Kafi
altTitles: al-Kafi fi Usul al-Din wa al-Ahkam
author: al-kulayni
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Kulayni's collection of reports from the Prophet and the Imams, arranged in books that begin with reason and knowledge, then the unity of God, prophecy and the imamate, and continue through purification, prayer, alms, fasting, pilgrimage, marriage and the rest of the law. It is the largest of the Twelver Shia hadith collections and the earliest of the four canonical ones.
historicalContext: Compiled in Baghdad during the Minor Occultation, when the Twelver community was consolidating its legal and doctrinal tradition. Al-Kulayni's selection and arrangement gave later Shia jurists their core corpus, and the work is still read with the commentaries of Majlisi and others.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
